{{Top|leg}}
A '''refinement tube''' was a component used in the [[Emperor-4 beam tube]]. Twelve refinement tubes were installed in the weapon, and the components helped to create and focus the high-energy [[Particle beam/Legends|particle beam]] in conjunction with four [[Energy cycler/Legends|energy cyclers]] and four low-grade [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. The refinement tubes were sensitive and easy to knock out of alignment. Reconfiguring the tubes to allow the weapon to function took almost four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
